reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was "no magnesium oxide" and 100 mg elemental per capsule, plus the QR to a named ISO 17025 lab report, which is exactly what I check on a label. At about $1 a day with free shipping I would try one box, but only one, since my drawer is already full of half-used bottles.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps, or will this be another bottle I stop taking after two weeks? I also have no idea yet whether the lab report is real until I scan it.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not open to a real batch result with the magnesium content matching the label, I would not buy.
